SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS Name, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS MaxLength
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME = @Table AND TABLE_SCHEMA IN (SCHEMA_NAME(), 'dbo')

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS TableName, c.name AS ColumnName
FROM sys.columns c
WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.GlobalParameter'), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ExtraBedInv'),
                      OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.TransactionCode'), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.HotelParameter'),
                      OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SpecialService'), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.TaxDef'),
                      OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ServiceCharge'))

SELECT DISTINCT TOP (2) LTRIM(RTRIM(HotelID)) AS HotelID
FROM dbo.GlobalParameter
WHERE ParaName IN (@Names1,@Names2,@Names3,@Names4,@Names5,@Names6) AND HotelID IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(HotelID)) <> ''

SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ParaName)) AS ParaName, ParaString
FROM dbo.GlobalParameter
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(HotelID)) = @HotelId AND ParaName IN (@Names1,@Names2,@Names3,@Names4,@Names5,@Names6)
SELECT SUM(CAST(NumBed AS bigint)) FROM dbo.ExtraBedInv WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(HotelID)) = @HotelId

SELECT TOP (1) LTRIM(RTRIM(SpecialServiceCode)) AS Code,
       NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(20), TrnCode))), '') AS TrnCode,
       NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(20), TrnSubCode))), '') AS TrnSub,
       TRY_CONVERT(int, OpenPrice) AS OpenPrice,
       TRY_CONVERT(int, IncludeInRoomCharge) AS IncludeInRoomCharge,
       TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18, 2), AmountCharge) AS AmountCharge
FROM dbo.SpecialService
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(SpecialServiceCode)) = @Code

SELECT TOP (1) LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), TaxCode))) AS TaxCode,
       LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), ServiceChargeCode))) AS ServiceChargeCode,
       LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), STaxCode))) AS STaxCode
FROM dbo.TransactionCode
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(TransactionCode)) = @Code
  AND (@Sub IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(20), TransactionSubCode))) = @Sub)
ORDER BY LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(20), TransactionSubCode))), TaxCode, ServiceChargeCode

SELECT DISTINCT TOP (2) LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), TaxCode))) AS TaxCode,
       LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), ServiceChargeCode))) AS ServiceChargeCode,
       LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), STaxCode))) AS STaxCode
FROM dbo.TransactionCode
WHERE AutoPost = 1

SELECT TOP (1) HotelDate FROM dbo.HotelParameter
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(HotelID)) = @HotelId

SELECT DISTINCT TOP (2) TRY_CONVERT(decimal(9, 6), ServiceRate) AS Rate
FROM dbo.ServiceCharge
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ServiceChargeCode)) = @Code

SELECT DISTINCT TOP (2) TRY_CONVERT(decimal(9, 6), TaxRate) AS Rate
FROM dbo.TaxDef
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(TaxCode)) = @Code

SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS Name, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS MaxLength
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME = @Table AND TABLE_SCHEMA IN (SCHEMA_NAME(), 'dbo')

SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS Name, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS MaxLength
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME = @Table AND TABLE_SCHEMA IN (SCHEMA_NAME(), 'dbo')

SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS Name, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS MaxLength
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME = @Table AND TABLE_SCHEMA IN (SCHEMA_NAME(), 'dbo')
SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; BEGIN TRANSACTION
sp_getapplock

UPDATE Folio SET RoomTypeBooked = @RoomTypeBooked, ArrivalDate = @ArrivalDate, DepartureDate = @DepartureDate, NumAdult = @NumAdult, NumChild = @NumChild, NumEnf = @NumEnf, RateAmount = @RateAmount, LastName = @LastName, ExtraBed = @ExtraBed, FirstName = COALESCE(@FirstName, FirstName), RoomTypeCode = @RoomTypeCode, RateOverideFlag = @RateOverideFlag, LastChangeTime = GETDATE(), LastChangeClerkID = @LastChangeClerkID WHERE FolioNum = @FolioNum
DELETE FROM FolioRate WHERE FolioNum = @FolioNum

INSERT INTO FolioRate (FolioNum, hDate, ToDate, RateAmount, isCancel, RateOverride, CreateBy, CreateTime, DscPcnt, DscAmount) VALUES (@FolioNum, @hDate, @ToDate, @RateAmount, 0, @RateOverride, @CreateBy, GETDATE(), @DscPcnt, @DscAmount)

INSERT INTO FolioRate (FolioNum, hDate, ToDate, RateAmount, isCancel, RateOverride, CreateBy, CreateTime, DscPcnt, DscAmount) VALUES (@FolioNum, @hDate, @ToDate, @RateAmount, 0, @RateOverride, @CreateBy, GETDATE(), @DscPcnt, @DscAmount)
SELECT ConfirmNum, OriginCode FROM Folio WHERE FolioNum = @FolioNum

SELECT a.IdAddition,
       CASE WHEN a.IdAddition <> m.IdAddition
             AND ISNULL(a.FirstName, '') = ISNULL(m.FirstName, '')
             AND ISNULL(a.LastName, '') = ISNULL(m.LastName, '')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsPlaceholder,
       CAST(ISNULL(a.IsChild, 0) AS int) AS IsChild
FROM AdditionalName a
CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x.IdAddition, x.FirstName, x.LastName FROM AdditionalName x
             WHERE x.FolioNum = @FolioNum AND ISNULL(x.ACancelNum, 0) = 0
             ORDER BY x.IdAddition) m
WHERE a.FolioNum = @FolioNum AND ISNULL(a.ACancelNum, 0) = 0
ORDER BY a.IdAddition

INSERT INTO AdditionalName (FirstName, LastName, ArrivalTime, DepartureTime, FolioNum, ACancelNum, AdtStatus, IsChild, VIPLevel, FolioSubNum, ConfirmNum, AOriginCode) VALUES (@FirstName, @LastName, @ArrivalTime, @DepartureTime, @FolioNum, 0, @AdtStatus, @IsChild, @VIPLevel, @FolioSubNum, @ConfirmNum, @AOriginCode)

INSERT INTO AdditionalName (FirstName, LastName, ArrivalTime, DepartureTime, FolioNum, ACancelNum, AdtStatus, IsChild, VIPLevel, FolioSubNum, ConfirmNum, AOriginCode) VALUES (@FirstName, @LastName, @ArrivalTime, @DepartureTime, @FolioNum, 0, @AdtStatus, @IsChild, @VIPLevel, @FolioSubNum, @ConfirmNum, @AOriginCode)

INSERT INTO AdditionalName (FirstName, LastName, ArrivalTime, DepartureTime, FolioNum, ACancelNum, AdtStatus, IsChild, VIPLevel, FolioSubNum, ConfirmNum, AOriginCode) VALUES (@FirstName, @LastName, @ArrivalTime, @DepartureTime, @FolioNum, 0, @AdtStatus, @IsChild, @VIPLevel, @FolioSubNum, @ConfirmNum, @AOriginCode)

SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(SpecialCode, ''))) AS SpecialCode, CAST(ISNULL(Qty, 0) AS int) AS Qty,
       CAST(ISNULL(Price, 0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS Price, CAST(ISNULL(FromDay, 0) AS int) AS FromDay,
       CAST(ISNULL(ToDay, 0) AS int) AS ToDay, CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CancelNum, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS bit) AS Cancelled
FROM Folio_Special WITH (UPDLOCK)
WHERE FolioNum = @FolioNum AND SPNotes LIKE @Marker
DELETE FROM Folio_Special WHERE FolioNum = @FolioNum AND SPNotes LIKE @Marker
SELECT COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Folio_Special'), 'nSeq', 'IsIdentity')
INSERT INTO Folio_Special (FolioNum, SpecialCode, Qty, Price, FromDay, ToDay, SPNotes, CancelNum) VALUES (@FolioNum, @SpecialCode, @Qty, @Price, @FromDay, @ToDay, @SPNotes, 0)
SELECT UserInfo3 FROM Folio WHERE FolioNum = @FolioNum
COMMIT TRANSACTION
SET LOCK_TIMEOUT -1
